app.title: Wordleaf
app.credit: Wordleaf is an unofficial fan project inspired by the board game So Clover! by François Romain (Repos Production). Not affiliated with the publisher. Go play the original!

lobby.title: Lobby

levels.name: Easy
levels.desc: Random words. The decoy card only has themes that are not on the clover, so it is easy to spot.

levels.name: Medium
levels.desc: Random words, but each word on the decoy card shares a theme with a word next to a clue (like Lion and Tiger), so it looks like it belongs.

levels.name: Hard
levels.desc: The whole clover and the decoy come from about three themes (like animals, food and weather). Clues have to be precise, and every card looks like it could fit anywhere.

rules: Everyone gets a clover with 4 word cards. Each leaf touches two words.
Write one single-word clue per leaf that links both words.
Then each clover is solved in turn: the cards are shuffled with one extra decoy card, and the others have to place and rotate them correctly using the clues.
The author stays silent! All 4 right on the first try: 6 points. Otherwise the correct cards stay, the rest go back, and a second try scores 1 point per correct card.

map.title: Where people play
map.note: Each dot is a place where people have played in the last year, colored by the most recent game there. Locations are approximate (from the IP address, rounded to about 10 km) and anonymous. Tap the legend to show or hide a group.

install.title: Install Wordleaf
install.intro: Add Wordleaf to your home screen. It opens full screen like a normal app, with no download and no app store.

ios: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap “Add”. Wordleaf is now on your home screen.
android: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
Confirm. Wordleaf is now on your home screen.

note.ios: Don't see “Add to Home Screen”? Tap “Edit Actions…” at the bottom of the share menu to add it.
note.android: Other browsers like Samsung Internet or Firefox have the same option in their menu.
